summary: Cuyahoga County's official MyPlace viewer and GIS REST catalog establish a local parcel-data custodian serving Parma, with indexed evidence of native PARCELPIN identities and parcel services. Direct anonymous viewer/REST requests timed out or were inaccessible from this environment, so no parcel geometry sample is retained.
queryOutcomes: Separate English and native/local-language (English, the US local language) discovery queries, exact text, outcomes and first-party URLs are recorded in city-8046-parma.json.
requestOutcomes: Attempted the official MyPlace viewer, consolidated parcel map metadata, a bounded Parma envelope query requesting only PARCELPIN plus geometry, and the parcel-fabric FeatureServer catalog. The viewer and direct REST host timed out; indexed first-party metadata supplied service/schema/CRS evidence. No successful geometry response is claimed.
scopeLimits: Exact WUP point and population fields were preserved; no coordinate was shifted.
No exact-point hit or miss inference was made.
A timeout, inaccessible viewer, unavailable bounded endpoint or missing geometry response is not evidence of citywide cadastral absence.
County parcel service/catalog evidence establishes local custody but does not establish citywide live geometry completeness or update currency.
No owner, address, contact, titleholder, personal, tax/account or other unsafe fields were requested or retained.
Packet completion is not source integration/admission; serial reviewer qualification remains required.
